bearerApiKey.description: Partner API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

info.title: Rimbun Partner API
info.description: Programmatic contract for financial institutions integrating Rimbun: ingest transactions, read explainable recommendations, and report outcomes.

post.summary: Enqueue async ingestion for a canonical bank statement (partner HMAC)
post.description: Authenticates via HMAC headers documented in docs/guides/partners/PARTNER_INGESTION_SIGNING.md. Returns 202 with a job id; processing happens asynchronously.

get.summary: Get banking product recommendations for a partner customer
get.description: Partner API. Authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. `customerId` is the partner's customer identifier (same as `providerAccountId` in ingestion). Tenant scope is resolved from the API key.

put.summary: Upsert assessment score data for a customer
put.description: Replaces questionnaire capture (`response_groups` / `user_responses`). Stores JSON in `rimbun_tenant.assessment_score`.

post.summary: Create a financial goal for a customer
Add an existing banking product to a customer profile

put.summary: Update an existing product balance on a customer banking profile

delete.summary: Remove a product from a customer banking profile

put.summary: Upsert economic profile for a customer

post.summary: Record a product detail view for People Like You insights
post.description: Bank sends when a customer views a banking or insurance product. Segment snapshot is derived server-side.

post.summary: Add an existing insurance policy to a customer profile

put.summary: Update an insurance policy on a customer profile

delete.summary: Remove an insurance policy from a customer profile
